why: amendment A2: the step `fill(t, k)` writes t and the name it came from (user), and every other name for that object (u); a read of the length moved before the step is not the read after it, so neither unit may be PASS-proved (design/w1d-opaque-async.md). LEAN_BREAK=async-drop-origins flips both to a false proof (the break row); bump: the step rebinds k in its argument, so k is a write; branch: the step sits in an if, whose result carries the step's writes
